scenarios.assumptions:
All leaf attacks available at the costs of Fig. 4.
Source: Schneier, B. (1999). Attack Trees. Dr. Dobb's Journal, December 1999. Public copy https://www.schneier.com/academic/archives/1999/12/attack_trees.html (fetched 2026-11-18). Used: Fig. 2 'Possible Attacks' (P/I), Fig. 3 'Special Equipment Required' (SE/NSE), Fig. 4 'Cost of Attack' ($), Fig. 6 'Cheapest Attack Requiring No Special Equipment'. The web copy has no page numbers.
Transcription notes: Values transcribed from the figure images (GIFs) on the public page. Fig. 4 prints the root as $10K and highlights Cut Open Safe; the text says OR nodes take the cheapest child and AND nodes the sum of their children. Scenario 1 expected = paper (Fig. 4). Scenario 2: Fig. 2 gives only P/I (root P, two possible attacks: cut open safe, bribe); the cost 10000 combines Fig. 2 with Fig. 4 costs and is my computation, not printed. Scenario 3: Fig. 6 prints the root as 'NSE/$20K' and the text says the cheapest attack needing no special equipment is bribing the person who knows the combination; this matches. Fig. 3 marks all leaves (SE: Pick Lock, Cut Open Safe, Listen to Conversation; all other leaves NSE), so the scenario is complete. Modelling choices: one fact per internal node; the cost-0 'open_with_combo', 'use_combo_from_target' and 'eavesdrop_to_combo' actions only carry an OR child up to its OR parent; the witness lists them because they are needed for reachability. Fig. 5 (attacks under $100K) and Figs. 7-8 (PGP, general system) were not transcribed.

semantics: Conditions are persistent Boolean facts; there are no delete effects or negation.
AND requires all incoming inputs; OR requires at least one. Unlabelled joins use the per-scenario AND/OR choice.
An action is enabled when its inputs hold (or it is an approved entry action); executing it assumes success.
Each action executes at most once; efforts are nonnegative, additive, and shared actions are charged once.
Minimum effort is an exact search over closed active sets; limits yield an incomplete result, never a minimum or unreachability.
importDefaults: New imports: root and declared starting conditions true; root actions allowed as entries.
New imports: unlabelled joins default to OR; missing efforts default to 1; goal = reachable node of greatest minimum dependency depth.
